ambiguous_lock_decision.question: One migration policy needs your decision: a save that skipped MIR 3.2.2 can retain a researched-but-locked planet, but there is no saved marker distinguishing the old MIR defect from an intentional lock by another mod. For these ambiguous later saves, should MIR preserve the lock and offer an explicit one-time repair, or automatically restore every researched discovery? The first choice best preserves other mods’ intent.
